title: World Cup 2026 Host Cities
description: 16 cities, 3 countries, one tournament. Know where the action is.

questions.q: How many host cities will stage 2026 World Cup matches?
questions.explain: 16 cities across the USA, Canada and Mexico.

questions.q: How many of the host cities are in the United States?
questions.explain: 11 US cities, plus 3 in Mexico and 2 in Canada.

questions.q: Which two Canadian cities are hosting matches?
questions.explain: Toronto and Vancouver (BC Place) are the Canadian hosts.

questions.q: Which three Mexican cities are hosting?
questions.explain: Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey are the Mexican hosts.

questions.q: In which stadium will the 2026 final be played?
questions.explain: The final is at the New York New Jersey Stadium (MetLife).

questions.q: The opening match is scheduled in which city?
questions.explain: Mexico City's stadium hosts the opener.

questions.q: Which of these US cities is NOT a 2026 host?
questions.explain: Chicago is not hosting; Seattle, Atlanta and Kansas City are.

questions.q: Which Canadian venue is known as BC Place?
questions.explain: BC Place in Vancouver is one of the two Canadian host venues.

questions.q: MetLife Stadium, hosting the 2026 final, is located in which US state?
questions.explain: Despite its New York branding, MetLife Stadium is in East Rutherford, New Jersey — just across the Hudson River from Manhattan.

questions.q: Azteca Stadium in Mexico City has hosted two previous World Cup finals. In which years?
questions.explain: Azteca hosted the 1970 final (Brazil 4–1 Italy) and the 1986 final (Argentina 3–2 West Germany), making it the only stadium to host two World Cup finals.
